zh.title: 台灣虎航9月1日起調整訂位服務費 各航段調升50元
zh.summary: 台灣虎航9月1日起調漲訂位服務費；非旺季每航段350元，旺季450元
body: 台灣虎航於官網宣布，自2026年9月1日起調整訂位服務費收費標準。非旺季航班每位旅客每航段訂位服務費由300元調升至350元，旺季航班則由400元調升至450元。
航空公司指出，若旅客於2026年8月31日（含）前完成購票，並於9月1日（含）後辦理航班改期，訂位服務費將依變更當時之標準重新計算。若改期後適用費用高於原支付金額需補收差額，低於原支付金額則不退還。
訂位服務費係透過全球分銷系統（GDS）隨機票票券收取。目前包含中華航空、長榮航空、星宇航空及台灣虎航等國籍航空公司，均依使用者付費原則收取相關服務費用。

en.title: Tigerair Taiwan to Raise Booking Service Fees Starting September 1
en.summary: Tigerair Taiwan will adjust booking service fees on September 1, raising rates by 50 TWD per segment.
body: Tigerair Taiwan announced an adjustment to its booking service fees effective September 1, 2026. The fee per passenger per flight segment will increase from 300 TWD to 350 TWD for off-peak flights, and from 400 TWD to 450 TWD for peak season flights.

For tickets bought on or before August 31, 2026, that are changed on or after September 1, 2026, booking fees will be recalculated under the new rates. Passengers must pay any price increase, but lower fee differences will not be refunded.

Booking service fees are collected alongside airfares for services provided through Global Distribution Systems (GDS). Taiwanese carriers including China Airlines, EVA Airways, STARLUX Airlines, and Tigerair Taiwan collect these fees based on user-pay principles.
